properties.description: Carga fechas de silver.races hacia gold.dim_date. Ajustar referencia del dataset Silver al nombre real en ADF.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT DISTINCT CAST(YEAR(d.full_date) * 10000 + MONTH(d.full_date) * 100 + DAY(d.full_date) AS int) AS date_sk, d.full_date, CAST(YEAR(d.full_date) AS smallint) AS [year], CONCAT((YEAR(d.full_date) / 10) * 10, \'s\') AS decade, CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, d.full_date) AS tinyint) AS [quarter], CAST(MONTH(d.full_date) AS tinyint) AS [month], CHOOSE(MONTH(d.full_date), \'Enero\',\'Febrero\',\'Marzo\',\'Abril\',\'Mayo\',\'Junio\',\'Julio\',\'Agosto\',\'Septiembre\',\'Octubre\',\'Noviembre\',\'Diciembre\') AS month_name, CHOOSE((DATEDIFF(DAY, \'19000101\', d.full_date) % 7 + 7) % 7 + 1, \'Lunes\',\'Martes\',\'Miercoles\',\'Jueves\',\'Viernes\',\'Sabado\',\'Domingo\') AS day_of_week FROM (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(date, [date]) AS full_date FROM silver.races) d WHERE d.full_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_date existing WHERE existing.full_date = d.full_date)',
